decisions.reason: As the flagship digital product line aligned with the firm's strategic direction and built on established capabilities, it likely meets aspirations and receives continued investment.

The continuing education institute leverages existing training resources and complements the core software, and with organizational slack and no performance shortfall, it is kept with a low drop probability.
The remote support tool enhances customer support efficiency and is close to established activities, so despite uncertain standalone results, organizational slack supports keeping it.
The analytics dashboard builds on existing software and responds to growing demand for performance insights, so it likely meets aspirations and is kept.
The complete practice bundle packages established modules and aligns with customer needs, so it likely performs at or above aspirations and is kept.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from the established offer and may face a performance shortfall relative to aspirations, but slack still allows keeping it for now.
